review: self-reviewed by the same model agent; no human or independent author-reviewer separation
policy_blind: policy-blind by instruction; only demo_reference.json was read for source content
evaluation_unit: the actual full document text as the cached answer
sufficiency_rule: Sufficient only when the full cached answer directly answers every new requirement without changed code, changed facts, or additional reasoning; related information alone is insufficient.
sampling: 30 authored questions, ordered by source document: five equivalent-intent requests and five plausible mismatches or added requirements per document
limitations: Model-authored, self-reviewed judgments are not ground truth. No quality or performance claims are made.
